finding: 2026-09-27 read-only Cosmos census (card_catalog point reads by id+pk, never cross-partition) of the 892 unsigned-twin pairs that repoint-sales-by-list REPORT (run 36351266066, scope backend/data/sales-repoints/2026-09-27-baseball-unsigned-twins-r0927d.json) refused as product-mismatch: the fromId (:no-auto twin) and toId (:auto checklist-grade twin) card_catalog rows disagree with each other on setKey EVEN THOUGH both ids carry the setKey segment their own address already commits to. Root cause: a stored setKey field written by an ingest disagreeing with the id it was written onto -- not a wrong address, a wrong field. 869 of 892 rows are repaired here (the side whose STORED setKey differs from its OWN id's setKey segment, restricted to twins whose checklist-grade :auto address is itself confirmed isAuto=true); 23 are held back to census.needsRuling because the presumed checklist-grade address is itself stored isAuto=false.
rulings: AUTHORIZATION (Drew, 2026-09-27 ~21:57Z): "Read-only census, then repair PR" -- read-only Cosmos census of the 892 product-mismatch refusals from run 36351266066, followed by a patchFields repair-list PR. APPLY not authorized by this PR.

DEFECT (2026-09-27 census): 892 card_catalog rows carry a stored setKey field that disagrees with the setKey segment already baked into their own id. 761 on the :auto (checklist-grade) twin ("to-wrong": 760 CPA- 2024 bowman-chrome rows stored setKey="bowman" on a bowman-chrome id, source checklistcenter-2026-08-29; 1 BPA- 2024 topps row stored setKey="topps-diamond-icons" on a topps id, source beckett-checklist-2026-08-27). 131 on the :no-auto twin ("from-wrong": 77 rows -- 90AU-/FPA- 2025 topps -- stored setKey="topps-celebration-series-1" on a topps id, source checklistinsider-2026-08-27; 54 CRA- rows stored setKey=null (absent, not merely wrong) on a bowman-chrome or bowman id, source checklist-batch-fill).

RULING BOUNDARY (this PR, applying the doctrine "setKey field is repaired to match the id's own segment ONLY when the id is the checklist-grade address"): the checklist-grade address is identified by isAuto=true on the presumed :auto twin, verified per-row this census. All 761 to-wrong rows and 77 of the 131 from-wrong rows (90AU-/FPA-, plus the 31 CRA- rows whose :auto twin IS stored isAuto=true) pass this gate -- 869 total, listed under entries below. The remaining 23 CRA- 2025 bowman-chrome rows do NOT: their :auto twin is itself stored isAuto=false, meaning the presumed checklist-grade address carries the same checklistinsider-layout-mints-autos-unsigned defect (#1611-family) this whole repoint program exists to fix. Patching the :no-auto twin's setKey to match its id there would aim a future sale at an address whose own auto identity is unconfirmed. Held in census.needsRuling, excluded from entries.

SOURCE OF THE WRONG ROWS, BY INGEST BATCH: checklistinsider-2026-08-27 (653 rows, all 90AU-/FPA- 2025 topps from-wrong plus a portion of the CPA- to-wrong group is checklistcenter, not this batch -- see exact breakdown in census.histograms.sourceOfWrongRows), checklistcenter-2026-08-29 (184 rows, the CPA- 2024 bowman-chrome to-wrong group), checklist-batch-fill (31 of the 54 CRA- from-wrong rows -- the ones with a confirmed-auto twin; the other 23 are checklist-batch-fill too but held to needsRuling), beckett-checklist-2026-08-27 (1 row, BPA- 2024 topps). Not a single ingest package: two checklist* batches (checklistinsider, checklistcenter) plus one internal batch-fill account for all 869+23 wrong rows; no drift found on sport, year or cardNumber -- only setKey (and, incidentally, parallel differs by design between the twins' own :no-auto/:auto identity, not a defect).

ACTION: patchFields (extended in this PR) -- relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs's patchFields shape now takes an optional "field" ("parallel", the existing default, or "setKey"). A setKey entry supplies NO value: the correct value is read off the entry's own id (idSetKey(id)), verified again at write time against the live id rather than trusted from classify, and patched through patchCatalogRowFields alone -- no parallel/search-field rebuild, since only the setKey field itself is wrong. The id never changes.
